title: encrypt() doc: panic path from RSA encrypt not clearly documented
description: smime-tree/src/encrypt.rs: RNG preflight converts getrandom error to SmimeError::RngFailure. But rsa_pub.encrypt() can still panic if the OS RNG fails at that point. Function doc says 'Panics if the OS RNG fails while encrypting for RSA recipient' but doesn't clarify that SmimeError::RngFailure covers only the preflight, not the encrypt call. Callers may be confused about the two separate failure modes.
